the optimal control of an autonomous hybrid photovoltaic/ battery storage generation unit in micro grid applications to supply a variable speed induction motor driven industrial load and/or a DC water pump.
the design and implementation of an efficient and reliable photovoltaic/ energy storage generation unit to supply dynamic loads in a micro grid system.

the proposed optimal control can increase the efficiency of the entire system by increasing the power output of the photovoltaic generation system and by controlling and managing the charge-discharge modes of the battery storage.
we are able to design a hybrid photovoltaic/ battery storage unit that is able to supply both induction motor and DC motor loads with good performance.

we have proposed a photovoltaic storage system with an optimal control based on the Artificial Bee Colony algorithm to increase the photovoltaic power generation and the battery storage charge-discharge efficiencies.

the proposed photovotaic/energy storage system is able to supply dynamic loads and can be used in micro grid applications.
